text:
devon: Heads-up: saw several interactive pods getting bumped from us-west1 between 03:00-05:00 due to batch spot churn. UX latency spikes ~300ms p95 -> users complaining. Anyone else seeing this?
ops-bot: autoscaler: detected 47 preemptions in cluster-usw1 during window, avg reclaim wait 18s. scaling event triggered.
lina: Yup - noticed in grafana. p95 token latency up 25% for small sequences. Batch jobs are filling the cheap spot pool overnight.
mike: Current cost mix is 72% spot, 28% reserved. We want to keep cost but need QoS. Proposal: carve a small 'interactive-warm' reserved pool sized 8-12 GPUs for peak interactive windows and allow burst into spot with graceful eviction.
sara: Do we have eviction metrics by machine type? Some G5s have lower interruption rate in weekdays. Maybe region-aware warm buckets.
reza: We ran a sim last week: 10 GPU warm pool reduced interactive preemptions by 85% for <2s tails, cost +6% overall. I have results.
devon: Can you drop sim output? Also how to handle KV cache warming when we float instances?
reza: Attached snippet:
```
sim: warm_pool=10, spot_mix=0.68, interruption_rate=0.12 -> p99 interactive latency -120ms
cost_delta=+0.06
```
karen: For cache: we can migrate prefix cache to shared redis for interactive sessions, warmup on attach. Tradeoff: added network hop adds ~3ms.
lina: Maybe hybrid scheduling: tag batch jobs with anti-affinity to interactive-nodes and set preemptibleScore so scheduler prefers spilling batches first.
mike: Also consider off-peak shift policy: increase spot fraction to 90% from 02:00-06:00 for batch-only queues; shrink interactive warm pool to min during low usage.
sara: @mike can we automate that with existing admission controller? If yes, what's risk?
mike: Yes, we can encode in autoscaler policies + queue constraints. Risk: misclassification of jobs -> impact. Need canary for 24h.
devon: Action items: (1) reza share sim artifact link, (2) infra to prototype 10-GPU interactive-warm pool in us-west1-canary, (3) devex to test KV-shared approach. @lina @karen volunteer?
lina: :thumbsup: I can run the canary test next Tue night.
karen: I'll prototype redis-backed prefix cache + small lib change. ETA 5d.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INFRA-8421 for warm-pool canary; assign devon, reza, lina, karen.
devon: Thanks. Let's sync briefly tomorrow. If we see >10s preemption bursts we revert.
